info.title: ServiceBusManagementClient

requests.description: Lists all of the available ServiceBus REST API operations.
requests.name: GET /providers/Microsoft.ServiceBus/operations

requests.description: Gets all the available namespaces within the subscription, irrespective of the resource groups.
requests.name: GET /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/providers/Microsoft.ServiceBus/namespaces
requests.note: Replace {{SERVICEBUSMANAGEMENTCLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets the available namespaces within a resource group.
requests.name: GET /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.ServiceBus/namespaces
requests.note: Replace {{SERVICEBUSMANAGEMENTCLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Deletes an existing namespace. This operation also removes all associated resources under the namespace.
requests.name: DELETE /subscriptions/{subscriptionId}/resourceGroups/{resourceGroupName}/providers/Microsoft.ServiceBus/namespaces/{namespaceName}
requests.note: Replace {{SERVICEBUSMANAGEMENTCLIENT_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
